items.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it reminded me of something Harry “Sweets” Edison said.

ctx.x: Yeah. Boy I tell you when I was younger we used to — I could have taught it easily.

Before I forget, I was looking at the course listing at Eastman for a four year degree and it reminded me of something Harry “Sweets” Edison said. I’m paraphrasing a little bit, nowadays it seems like musicians have their idols and they don’t venture anyplace else. It’s better to be the world’s worst originator than the world’s greatest imitator. information the people from Sweets’ generation over and over said everybody sounds the same. How do you think players can avoid that?
